title: Fail-closed precise OpenAPI legacy registry transition

phases.objective: Allow one known legacy completion-certification operation to transition from an inline root contract to its registered precise static path-item reference, without weakening conflict detection for malformed or unrelated operations.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact known completion-certification inline operation is replaced by its registry `$ref`; wrong identity, security, source metadata, or path remains blocked with the existing conflict code.
steps: Load the registered completion-certification path and its existing inline root operation.
Require the exact allowlisted signature and operationId.
Require the exact admin bearer/backend API key security profile and consequential mutation flag.
Require a non-empty summary and response contract with no conflicting runtime source or completeness metadata.
Replace the whole path item with the exact registered static `$ref` only when every condition passes.
Reject malformed operationId, reduced security, conflicting source metadata, and unrelated paths without writing the OpenAPI document.
assertions: The operation remains consequential and uses the exact admin security alternatives.
Successful composition produces the precise registry `$ref` and zero remaining conflicts.
Malformed or unrelated inline operations remain `registered_path_inline_contract_not_replaceable`.
No SQL, migration authorization or Apply, registry activation sync, provider call, credential access, deployment, restart, Production ref mutation, or external send occurs.

phases.objective: Run Protected Promotion Generated Artifact Refresh on a non-merge Production comparison and commit the generated root OpenAPI `$ref` to the repair branch.
Keep all non-allowlisted registered inline contracts fail-closed.
Rebuild and validate a fresh exact-main-tree Production candidate after the generated contract is merged.
Promote only an explicitly authorized exact candidate after cumulative OpenAPI generation and E2E checks pass.
